parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
A farmer buys a packet of seeds that produce plants with purple beans.
The packet states that the seeds are homozygous for bean colour.
Define the term homozygous.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The farmer plants the seeds and the bean plants grow.
When the beans are harvested the farmer notices that most of the beans are purple but a few
beans are green.
He decides that some of the plants carried the allele for the green coloured bean and that this
allele is recessive.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Define the term allele.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Suggest why the farmer decided that the allele for green coloured beans is recessive.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Describe the difference between the genotype and the phenotype of an organism.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
The farmer only wants large purple beans so he crosses the plants that produce the largest
purple beans and does this for several generations.
He does not breed from any plant that produces small or green beans.
Eventually all his plants produce only large purple beans.
What is this process called?
